SELECT
,ui.id as info_id,ui.first_name,ui.last_name,vc.reply_comment_id,vc.main_comment_id,vc.target_user_id, u.username, ui2.first_name as target_first_name, ui2.last_name as target_last_name, u2.username as target_username, mm.read_state as read_state, mm.id as message_id, cf.thumb_nail_url as thumb_nail_url FROM gc_video_comment AS vc LEFT JOIN gc_user AS u ON u.id=vc.user_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info ui on ui.id=u.info_id LEFT JOIN sys_file f on ui.avatar_file_id=f.id LEFT JOIN sys_file cf on vc.file_id=cf.id LEFT JOIN gc_user u2 on vc.target_user_id = u2.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info ui2 on ui2.id = u2.info_id left join gc_master_message mm on mm.video_comment_id = vc.id
WHERE vc.main_comment_id = #{mainId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
,ui.id as info_id,ui.first_name,ui.last_name
,(select count(1) from gc_video_comment where main_comment_id = vc.id) as comment_num ,(select count(1) from gc_user_fabulous where video_id = vc.video_id and target_user_id = vc.user_id and comment_id = vc.id) as fabulous_num
,COALESCE((select count(1) from gc_user_fabulous where user_id = #{userId} and video_id = vc.video_id and target_user_id = vc.user_id and comment_id = vc.id),0) as is_fabulous
FROM gc_video_comment AS vc LEFT JOIN gc_user AS u ON u.id=vc.user_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info ui on ui.id=u.info_id LEFT JOIN sys_file f on ui.avatar_file_id=f.id LEFT JOIN sys_file cf on vc.file_id=cf.id WHERE vc.video_id=#{vid} AND vc.main_comment_id is null AND vc.master_id=#{masterId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
